description: Semantic (meaning-based) search over the NEAR knowledge base: docs.near.org and partner docs, gov.near.org threads, NEAR release notes, blog, the ecosystem catalog and GitHub issues of NEAR repositories. NEAR only: not for other blockchains, the general web or local files. Use this for conceptual how-does-X-work questions; use search for exact-term or name lookups, and get_doc to read a full page once you have its id.

source_types.description: Restrict to these source types. Omit for all.

name: semantic_search
